headline: Operating profit surges while per-share earnings fall
summary_short: Consolidated revenue was KRW 5,426.9B (+22.2% y/y) and operating profit KRW 459.4B (+98.4% y/y), while EPS was KRW 4,331, down 36.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 4,331 fell 78.2% q/q and 36.2% y/y on the shard. Third-party reports of the filing put consolidated revenue at KRW 5,426.9B and operating profit at KRW 459.4B, up 22.2% and 98.4% y/y. Operating profit growth did not carry to per-share earnings. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from third-party news and StockHub summaries of the filing; the DART filing was not reached. EPS is Yahoo data and may differ from the company's reported basis.
